responsibility: Owns rustc's target specification model and infrastructure: the Target and TargetOptions data model, linker flavor taxonomy, JSON serialization/deserialization, built-in target support plumbing, and target tuple loading from names or custom files.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/mod.rs`, `abi/call/mod.rs`, `asm/mod.rs`, and `spec/base/mod.rs`, this is the top-level target-spec module: it owns the `Target`/`TargetOptions` model, linker-flavor taxonomy, JSON I/O, built-in target definitions, and loading targets from triples or custom files.
